scope: Opt-in owner-bound standard inline toolbars for local and shared rich editors, shared field widgets, exact native caret-format reads, normal-caret input routing and no-op reset planning. Existing default factories, schemas, ABI meanings, shared model 11 and journal 12 remain unchanged.

native.note: Default/rich configurations, strict native and Wasm Clippy, native format/range/preset contracts, generated consumer types and a fresh local Wasm build all pass. The new read preserves frozen local observations, native focus affinity, explicit pending plain and mutation authority; non-carets reject.

All private collaboration regressions pass. The new caret read checks the opaque observation before selection inspection, does not change checkpoints or authority, rejects stale/non-caret reads, and retains pending plain through restore.
The existing unused HasIdSpan import warning remains in unmodified vendor code. Root and private-workspace formatting also pass.

browserSuites.note: Final full run includes the local owner-binding check with its corrected presentation fixture.

Canonical coverage guard includes the new spec. Chromium/Firefox pass together (202 cases, 4.3 minutes); every WebKit file passes in its existing fresh process. No retries, skipped specs or deadline changes.

Final clean installed archives, without workspace links, pass standard controls and presentation, offline/shared history, independent network clients, reconnect, asset bytes and recovery workflows. Shared Wasm remains explicitly host-supplied.

browserRunCountNote: 546 overlapping suite executions in final qualification, not unique capabilities or a parity percentage. Earlier development runs are not added to this count. New fixture mistakes were corrected for canonical document keys, native outcome/affinity and block identities, publication revisions, nested-caption focus, Firefox's cloned synthetic clipboard stores and a missing local presentation reference; no assertion deadlines or retry policies were relaxed.

installedRuntime.note: Three fresh private archives install offline into a retained independent consumer. Package-root imports, generated TypeScript, matching local Wasm, standard toolbar/caret capabilities, rejection of an older capability surface, native catalog parity and exact recovered future history pass. The existing four-formats-by-257-paragraph quota regression remains included.

repairs.reproduction: At a styled caret, enable an inline control and type successive browser-automation keystrokes in a browser that supplies a collapsed beforeinput target.
repairs.before: The shared coordinator treated the matching caret target as range replacement. The first character was styled, but replacement cleared the pending override for the following input.
repairs.after: Matching caret coordinates route to normal typing and retain logical affinity/pending formats. Distinct browser replacement targets still replace their actual ranges. Local and shared controllers use the same coordinate-only helper; native protocols are unchanged.

repairs.reproduction: Reset an absent shared format while a Redo branch is retained.
repairs.before: A redundant disabled annotation could create an unnecessary shared history group. A direct native probe confirmed an absent removal changed Undo depth from 0 to 1.
repairs.after: Standard reset planning consults Rust presence state and skips absent kinds. Empty caret/range resets preserve exact checkpoints and future Redo. The original low-level disabled-annotation command retains its intentional semantics.

controlContracts: Rust exact/mixed/unavailable state drives all twelve standard kinds. Mixed scalar fields stay blank; partial mark presence is visibly mixed rather than guessed from DOM spans.

One field submission replaces one complete format map. A mixed Link requires an explicit URL and target. The existing closed HTTP(S) policy rejects unsafe editing values, while unsafe stored values remain inert data.

Exact native caret reads preserve application formats and explicit plain overrides. Clear standard formatting removes only standard kinds. Script activation explicitly removes the opposite kind in one history group.

Keyboard actions, Enter/Escape, dirty-form rejection after remote/selection-only changes, editable nested-caption focus, exact Undo/Redo/reload, internal clipboard and offline selective history are exercised.

Standard declarations bind to their creating owner. A foreign owner with the same schema rejects before host/document mutation. Owner-neutral custom controls remain reusable; existing two-argument and single-field controls remain supported.

A dirty form compares complete view data, not only document bytes. That stamp is not mutation authority: opaque Rust observations still admit every write. Alt-modified editor shortcuts are not intercepted.
otherChecks: Standalone script regressions pass with the three existing explicit opt-in diagnostic skips; shared consumer types and all 25 readiness-guard tests pass. The readiness guard still reports NOT RELEASE READY. Default browser source and archive are unchanged; its earlier unit-test count is not claimed as rerun here.
limits: Applying a format is complete-map replacement, not a per-property patch preserving other mixed values. Foreign interchange and autolink remain unfinished.
Caret reads reject non-carets and output beyond 64 KiB without truncation. Node/grid inline controls are unavailable. Existing command, schema, document, action and history budgets still apply.

The preset supports RGB24 colors, integer 8..96 pixel sizes, four font stacks and the bounded safe Link domain, not arbitrary CSS, custom downloaded fonts or general URLs. A toolbar widget admits at most eight fields.

Both toolbar factories require matching native capabilities and an explicitly selected standard profile/presentation. The unchanged ABI number alone does not advertise this capability; older modules reject before mounting.

Public distribution promotion, React integration, structural editing gaps, natural typing groups, read-only mode, contextual menus and sanitized foreign interchange remain active first-two-workstream goal work. Feature labels and all 13 qualification gates remain unchanged.

Synthetic clipboard/composition events and automated browser keystrokes do not qualify native OS clipboard, physical IME, screen readers, mobile, sustained performance or public deployment. Those later release checks remain open.
